criteria.requirement: Scholarships are open to applicants from all countries and professional or academic backgrounds (only nationals or permanent residents of ROC Taiwan apply through a separate foundation).
criteria.applicant: Nationality: Democratic Republic of the Congo.
criteria.quote: Applicants from all countries and professional/academic backgrounds.

criteria.requirement: Between 18 and 30 at the time of the forum, or between 18 and 35 for citizens of the Global South; the FAQ's UNCTAD definition of the Global South names Africa.
criteria.applicant: Recorded only as under 30, which is below the limit of 35 that applies to a citizen of the DRC (Africa).
criteria.quote: You are between 18 and 30 years of age (or between 18 and 35 for citizens of the Global South) at the time of the forum.

criteria.requirement: No degree required: non-graduates are welcome, and the most recent qualification or academic record is uploaded.
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: Yes, we welcome applications of non-graduates and strive to increase the percentage of non-academic scholarship holders at EFA.

criteria.requirement: English proficiency of at least B2 (CEFR), proved by a language certificate or another accepted document, such as a confirmation from a school, employer or university professor.
criteria.applicant: No IELTS, TOEFL or DELF score recorded; English is among the recorded languages, without a level.
criteria.missing: Proof of B2 English: a certificate or one of the other accepted confirmations.
criteria.quote: English proficiency at a minimum level of B2 according to the Common European Framework of Reference

criteria.requirement: Applicants must not have received an EFA scholarship before (first-time scholarship holders only; attending virtually in 2020 or 2021 does not count against them).
criteria.applicant: Earlier participation in the Forum is not recorded in the profile.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant has ever been granted an EFA scholarship.
criteria.quote: You have not received a scholarship from the European Forum Alpbach yet and therefore qualify as a first-time scholarship holder.

funding.conditions: The scholarship covers the Forum participation fee; the application itself is free of charge.
funding.quote: A scholarship of the EFA for the Forum covers the participation fee and accommodation costs.

funding.conditions: Rooms are booked by the EFA, mostly shared; applicants with sufficient means are encouraged to pay for their own accommodation.
funding.quote: A scholarship of the EFA for the Forum covers the participation fee and accommodation costs.

funding.conditions: A lump sum toward part of the travel costs may be awarded under the advanced scholarship, subject to funds.
funding.quote: Travel costs to and from Alpbach have to be covered by yourself, as well as health care and travel insurance.

funding.conditions: Health care and travel insurance are the participant's responsibility.
funding.quote: Travel costs to and from Alpbach have to be covered by yourself, as well as health care and travel insurance.

funding.conditions: Participants pay their own daily expenses during the Forum; most accommodation includes breakfast.
funding.quote: Participants are expected to cover their own daily expenses during the Forum.

funding.conditions: Advanced scholarship: a lump sum toward part of the travel costs and on-site expenses, awarded only to applicants with the greatest need and subject to available funds; the amount is not stated.
funding.quote: The European Forum Alpbach reviews all applications and awards the lump sum to applicants who demonstrate the greatest need for additional financial support.

out_of_pocket: Unknown amounts: the participant pays flights, the Schengen visa, health care and travel insurance, and daily expenses; the accommodation is valued at EUR 49 per night but is covered by the scholarship.

cycles.window_text: Applications open in March 2027; exact dates not announced.

cycles.quote: The European Forum Alpbach application platform will open from 2-22 March 2026.
